definition: A PTAS reduction transforms an optimization problem to another so that a polynomial-time approximation scheme for the latter yields one for the former.
entry_text: A PTAS reduction transforms an optimization problem to another so that a polynomial-time approximation scheme for the latter yields one for the former.
example: A researcher uses a PTAS reduction to transfer evidence of approximation difficulty between optimization problems.
label: PTAS reduction
sense_note: Formal definitions and notation vary; the key property is preservation of approximation-scheme existence.
